title: disperis capensis var. tenera
intro: Disperis capensis var. tenera, commonly known as the "Grass Vetchling" or "Slender Disperma", is a plant species belonging to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and improvement of cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Disperis capensis var. tenera include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
